laws.rule: Parque Nacional La Campana: The operator says the camping area is closed and only day visits are allowed. Access to the Cerro La Campana summit closes in winter under the cited Municipal Ordinance 772/2014. The current winter boundaries and reopening date were not checked. The named unit prohibits fires and other heat sources, pets or exotic animals, leaving enabled trails and removing natural resources. Follow ranger instructions; no region-wide extension is made.
